rawContent: Great conversation between @Bonn1eGreer & @AyoCaesar #HayFestival2021 Please, we mustn’t allow the long arc of history be like the rainbow, with its other end always a way off! It’s been too long a road to justice. #BlackLivesMatter
Where are the police who dragged away environmental protesters? #ClimateEmergency #Antilockdown

#JayGriffiths at #HayFestival2021 saying that, if we had the sense of Meerkats we would howl at the news of the #ClimateEmergency! instead we have dry discussion & make long term plans while the planet is in crisis.
Why are we not appropriately frightened about #climatecrisis in the same way we were about a pandemic? #JayGriffiths #HayFestival2021

@akalamusic’s book Natives: Race & Class (book of the week on #BBCR4 ) should be on the curriculum. We may not stop older generations perpetuating dominant stories around British abolition & legacy from the slave trade, we can replace them for younger ones, though. #slavery #BLM

👇This is how to challenge the cut to aid: pointing out the inequality of #ClimateCrisis & the debt owed to the countries most affected. Not by describing the aid as being to ‘tin shack schools’ with ‘one book’ #BobGeldof
@BBCr4today & not a mention of the #climatecrisis in that interview about cities, offices & working from home! #BBCR4today

Perhaps, as it’s a Friday, children can take the day off to protest about #ClimateCrisis rather than be forced to behave like North Koreans or 1930s Nazis? In the midst for #Windrush & #GrenfellTower, #DidoHarding’s comments & booing football fans, this is obscene.
@VicarofWokely @BishopWorcester @giles_fraser Well that’s Ok then! I’ll leave it to you to explain to the people who are starving, without water, or seeing their land disappear due to #ClimateCrisis

@CarlEKing @athenakugblenu The phrase ‘she meant well’ isn’t good enough 🤢 Now you’ve become part of her learning process, 🤢 kind of shows why #BlackLivesMatter  is needed but not ‘like that’. Us white people need to get on with dealing with our crap ourselves.

@BlackKnight10k @Polly_Pharmacy It doesn’t matter what colour we are, or the level of suffering we’ve experienced, if we use someone else’s personal loss as an opportunity to cause more pain we make ourselves smaller. Our world lacks justice & needs more compassion, that’s the fight. #BlackLivesMatter

@FrDidymus How are you defining ‘summer’? We’ve lived through a heat wave bad enough for the water company to ask us not to use hoses, & are now watching our water butts fill up. Some plants are late to flower & fruits, others are suggesting autumn. #ClimateCrisis + British weather.
@JhonCooper @mthr_jo @CanonJPemberton A shame the #ClimateCrisis isn’t temporary. They could at least recycle. I shan’t be getting involved with this unless the glasses are washable & reusable.
@revpaulwhite It happened early: remember the heat wave? It’s now autumn. It’s #ClimateCrisis we have to get used to it or do something about our govt, big business & communities.

At Paul’s Cathedral called the police on peaceful, courteous Christian #climate protesters. Yes, you read that correctly. The Cathedral cares more about its image than the #CofE investing in fossil fuels & killing the planet. 
https://t.co/b4yeOr9Tj3
Is there any evidence that consideration for people with #disabilities are being included in debates on #ClimateEmergency discussions & govt plans?
@BarclaysUK Two not for profit accounts will be moving from you, if you don’t stop investing in deforestation in Brazil. #ClimateCrisis #barclays
